migrationDelta.note: Manual Recon, RUN form/NDJSON dispatch, Auto/Forge and infrastructure/history transport moved out of the compatibility controller into typed services. The four remaining textual fetch occurrences are inert XSS cheatsheet examples; the controller has zero real fetch call sites. Help overlays moved 25 controller functions, 220 inline handlers and the shared Escape listener into declarative React state and events. Vigolium, Pipeline, Findings and Exports/Integrations share typed services/state while preserving compatibility globals, filenames, popup names, storage keys and BroadcastChannel contracts.
